text: Production review of Everyday mobility.
This draft has not been professionally approved and is not for exercise use.
The proposed session begins with a stable chair or wall, a clear space, and a comfortable pace.
The reviewer must confirm the movements, alternatives and timing before filming.
From an upright seat, turn the head slowly within a comfortable range.
Return to the middle before looking the other way.
Keep the shoulders relaxed.
A rest window follows.
The final narrator will invite the viewer to settle, take a comfortable breath, or pause for longer.
There is no target to chase.
Sit upright with feet grounded.
Cross your arms towards your shoulders.
Keep the hips facing forward as the upper body turns gently.
Return to centre before changing sides.
A rest window follows.
The final narrator will invite the viewer to settle, take a comfortable breath, or pause for longer.
There is no target to chase.
Stand with feet apart and arms by your sides.
Slide one hand a little down the same side, return upright, and change sides.
Keep the movement small.
A rest window follows.
The final narrator will invite the viewer to settle, take a comfortable breath, or pause for longer.
There is no target to chase.
Hands against a solid wall, take one foot back and keep its heel grounded.
Ease into a comfortable calf stretch, release, then change legs.
This is the proposed closing section.
The final instructor will guide a comfortable finish and remind the viewer that resting or doing less is welcome.
The session remains awaiting professional approval.
